a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly ends with both of us below 4 cells. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough for one unit right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round after that so you can reach 4.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. I'm sorry this breaks our agreement. If there's no storm, I'll operate every remaining round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take any more.
